text:
zoe: spotted KV eviction spike causing embed timeouts. cutting emergency hotfix v2.4.2, targeting EU change window 00:45-01:15 UTC. requesting expedited approval to skip canary because customers are impacted. more: https://confluence/release/v2.4.2 (root)
deploybot: Deploybot: preflight ok, tests passing. Canary-skip requires two release:approve.
harry: +1 from me if ops confirms capacity and oncall will monitor.
ops-oncall: eu-west1 has spare capacity. i'll stay on the thread and watch. +1.
zoe: rollback plan: immediate image pin to last-good sha 7f9c2a, traffic cut, no DB changes. auto-rollback if 5m error rate > 2%. commands:
```sh
# rollback
kubectl set image deploy/llm-service llm=image:7f9c2a -n prod-eu
deploybot rollback --thread 7081234000 --reason "auto-rollback"
```
harry: please add a one-line release note for support.
zoe: release note: "v2.4.2 — hotfix for KV eviction causing embed timeouts; rolling EU 00:45-01:15 UTC; no schema changes." link: https://docs/releases/v2.4.2-notes
deploybot: Deploybot: approvals=3 (zoe, harry, ops-oncall). Initiating rollout in 2m. logs: https://deploylogs/7081234000
deploybot: Phase 1 (25%) -> OK. Phase 2 (60%) -> OK. Phase 3 (100%) -> Completed. Metrics: kv-hit-rate improved ~88%, no increase in 5xx.
harry: sanity probe `curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" -X POST https://api.eu1.redwood/sanity -d '{}'` -> 200
ops-oncall: monitoring dashboards, no regressions.
zoe: closing rollout, tagging support/product to publish notes. :tada:
